Data and removal
Personal data export and erase requests (Tools → Export / erase personal data) include donor and shareholder fields on orders; on erase, values are anonymized as “[deleted]”.
Delete data when the plugin is removed Enabled
All product settings and plugin options are deleted. Orders and order records are not touched. This cannot be undone.
